item.text:
<linkedin_post>Kimi K3.1 Pro supports three reasoning levels: low, medium and max. The article’s author tested each one on the same prompt, asking the model to generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle, and ran the same comparison against Kimi K3.

That kind of repeated prompt gives a way to inspect differences in a specific output. Broader benchmark scores provide a separate measure: Artificial Analysis scored K3.1 Pro at 55, between Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 and several models at 53, including GPT-6 Astra.

K3.1 Pro is available through Moonshot’s API. Moonshot says it will release the full model weights by November 4.</linkedin_post>
